title: Home Assistant: one brain for your whole smart home

intro.headline: Your smart home shouldn't need the cloud.
intro.subhead: Home Assistant ties hundreds of devices from dozens of brands into one local dashboard that keeps working when the internet doesn't.

outro.headline: Take back the brain of your smart home.
outro.subhead: Home Assistant is free, runs on hardware you already own, and gets smarter with every integration. Which room are you automating first?
